metadata.overview: Reports Ocean.xyz mining pool account data (hashrate, workers, balances, revenue, history) and, when configured, the local DATUM gateway status. Read-only: pool and gateway state are polled over HTTP(S), no device writes.

telemetry.name: health
telemetry.description: Operational status only: OK, DEGRADED, or OFFLINE, plus active alert names. Does not return device opts, env, or credentials.

telemetry.name: hashrate
telemetry.description: Total pool-side hashrate across configured accounts (60s window). 0 before the first refresh, or when Ocean reports the account inactive.

telemetry.name: workers_online
telemetry.description: Workers with non-zero 600s hashrate across configured accounts. Idle workers are excluded. 0 before the first refresh.

telemetry.name: balance
telemetry.description: Unpaid earnings (Ocean statsnap unpaid) across configured accounts. 0 when the snapshot is missing.

telemetry.name: estimated_earnings
telemetry.description: Estimated earnings if the pool finds the next block, summed across configured accounts.

telemetry.name: stats
telemetry.description: Latest per-account stats snapshot: hashrate windows, balance, 24h revenue, unsettled, and estimated next-block earnings.

telemetry.name: stats_history
telemetry.description: Saved stats snapshots. Requires start and end (ms). Optional interval is 5m, 30m, 3h, or 1D.

telemetry.name: workers
telemetry.description: Latest worker list, or history when start and end are set. Optional offset, limit (max 100), and name.

telemetry.name: workers_count
telemetry.description: Worker-count samples. Requires start and end (ms).

telemetry.name: transactions
telemetry.description: Earnings rows. Requires start and end (ms). aggrHourly=true returns averaged hourly revenue instead of raw rows.

telemetry.name: blocks
telemetry.description: Pool blocks in a range. Requires start and end (ms). aggrMonthly=true returns monthly pool and site luck.

telemetry.name: alerts
telemetry.description: Currently active alerts. Ocean_pool_not_reachable and Datum_Offline.

telemetry.name: alerts_history
telemetry.description: Alert openings. Requires start and end (ms).

telemetry.name: yearly_balances
telemetry.description: Last 12 months of net rewards per configured account, in BTC.

telemetry.name: datum_stats
telemetry.description: DATUM gateway status, connections, and estimated hashrate. status is null when datumApiUrl is not configured.

telemetry.name: datum_client_stats
telemetry.description: DATUM decentralized client stats. Fails with ERR_DATUM_NOT_CONFIGURED when no gateway is configured.

telemetry.name: stratum_info
telemetry.description: DATUM stratum server info.

telemetry.name: stratum_job
telemetry.description: DATUM current stratum job.

telemetry.name: thread_stats
telemetry.description: DATUM thread stats.

telemetry.name: stratum_list
telemetry.description: Authenticated DATUM stratum client list. Requires DATUM_USER and DATUM_PASSWORD in env.

telemetry.name: coinbaser
telemetry.description: DATUM coinbaser payload.

telemetry.name: datum_config
telemetry.description: Authenticated DATUM configuration. Requires DATUM_USER and DATUM_PASSWORD in env. Secrets are not logged.

troubleshooting: If Ocean_pool_not_reachable, verify device opts apiUrl and outbound HTTPS connectivity to the Ocean API.
If Datum_Offline, verify the DATUM gateway process is running and device opts datumApiUrl points at its API port.
If hashrate and workers_online stay 0 while transactions exist, the Ocean username is valid but has no active workers.

errors.ERR_ACCOUNTS_REQUIRED: Device opts.accounts must be a non-empty list of Ocean usernames.
errors.ERR_OCEAN_REQUEST_FAILED: The Ocean HTTP call failed, timed out, or returned a non-2xx status.
errors.ERR_OCEAN_API_ERROR: Ocean returned an error payload, usually an unknown or inactive username.
errors.ERR_DATUM_NOT_CONFIGURED: A DATUM channel was pulled but datumApiUrl is not set.
errors.ERR_DATUM_CREDENTIALS_MISSING: An authenticated DATUM channel was pulled without DATUM_USER and DATUM_PASSWORD.
errors.ERR_DATUM_REQUEST_FAILED: The DATUM HTTP call failed, timed out, or returned a non-2xx status.
errors.ERR_DATUM_CLIENT_STATS_FETCH: DATUM decentralized client stats could not be read.
errors.ERR_STRATUM_INFO_FETCH: DATUM stratum server info could not be read.
errors.ERR_STRATUM_JOB_FETCH: DATUM current stratum job could not be read.
errors.ERR_THREAD_STATS_FETCH: DATUM thread stats could not be read.
errors.ERR_STRATUM_LIST_FETCH: DATUM stratum client list could not be read.
errors.ERR_COINBASER_FETCH: DATUM coinbaser payload could not be read.
errors.ERR_CONFIGURATION_FETCH: DATUM configuration could not be read.
errors.ERR_START_INVALID: A history channel was pulled without start.
errors.ERR_END_INVALID: A history channel was pulled without end.
errors.ERR_RANGE_INVALID: start or end is not a finite number.
